ABOUT US
JUST LIKE YOU, WE’RE DRIVEN BY AN APPRECIATION FOR PREMIUM WOOD MATERIALS, PERFORMANCE AND GETTING IT JUST RIGHT.

For 25 years, we’ve made a bet on saying ‘yes’ where most others would say no. Today, Chesapeake serves the broadest range of industries across the country with the most comprehensive selection of premium plywood products. Our team operates out of our expansive 150,000ft facilities – home to hundreds of premium products that we ship daily, coast to coast. 

Whether it’s a particular finish, hard-to-find sizes, or timeline constraints, we’re committed to making it happen through creative solutions that bring your vision to life. Bring us your challenge – we’ll make it happen.

ABOUT US

DELIVERING SOLUTIONS.

Every day, we make a bet on saying “yes.” Through our extensive wood inventory, innovative logistics business, spirit of ambition, and a service-above-all-else mentality, Chesapeake has become the premium wood supply & solutions partner for visionary makers.

OUR WOOD SOLUTIONS
HARDWOOD PLYWOOD

Engineered for strength, selected for beauty.

Our hardwood plywood range combines premium core construction with a wide selection of face veneers—perfect for cabinetry, millwork, furniture, and more. With in-stock options, custom grades, and dependable delivery, Chesapeake gives you the materials you need to build with confidence.

EXPLORE
LVL STAIR STRINGER & RISER

Built to Support Every Step

Our LVL stair stringers and risers are engineered for structural consistency, dimensional stability, and long-term performance. Ideal for residential and commercial builds, these materials are straight, strong, and ready to install—saving time on-site and delivering peace of mind underfoot.

EXPLORE
ARCHITECTURAL PLYWOOD

Where Precision Meets Aesthetics

Our architectural plywood pairs high-grade cores with stunning, hand-selected veneers—designed for projects where visual impact and performance matter most. Ideal for premium millwork, casework, and interior applications, each panel delivers consistency, elegance, and craftsmanship you can count on.

EXPLORE
FIRE RATED PLYWOOD

Built for Safety. Ready to Perform.

Our fire-rated plywood meets the strictest building codes without compromising on quality or workability. Perfect for commercial interiors, public spaces, and multi-family builds, these panels offer certified fire resistance, reliable strength, and fast delivery when timelines matter.

EXPLORE
MARINE PLYWOOD

Engineered for the Elements

Our marine-grade plywood is built to perform in wet, demanding environments. Made with waterproof adhesives and high-quality veneers, it offers superior durability, strength, and resistance to delamination—ideal for boatbuilding, coastal construction, and exterior applications where reliability matters.

EXPLORE
MEDIUM DENSITY FIBREBOARD

Smooth, Stable, and Built for Precision

Our MDF panels offer a clean surface, consistent density, and excellent machinability—making them ideal for painted finishes, routing, and detailed millwork. Available in multiple grades and thicknesses, Chesapeake stocks the MDF you need to build with accuracy and efficiency.

EXPLORE
EDGEBANDING

Clean edges. Strong protection. A seamless finish.

Durable, easy-to-apply edging strips that provide a seamless, professional finish for cabinetry and furniture.

EXPLORE
LAMINATES & VENEERS

Premium surfaces—synthetic durability or real-wood character.

Laminates and veneers are the materials that define the look, feel, and performance of your finished surfaces.

We’re meticulous about what makes it into our inventory — because your projects deserve nothing less than the best. Your satisfaction isn't just a priority — it's our promise.
